name: Red Jasper
description: Opaque, earthy and warm. Red jasper is traditionally worn for stamina and a steady, grounded kind of courage; the classic root-chakra stone.
mineral: Red jasper is an opaque, microcrystalline quartz coloured brick red by iron. Darker veins and spots are natural, so every bead looks slightly different.
wornFor: A red jasper bracelet is traditionally worn for stamina, grounding and steady courage. Red jasper is the classic root chakra stone, which is why it sits first in the root-to-crown row of The Seven, and it is linked with Aries and Scorpio. It suits people who want calm persistence rather than a burst of energy. Red jasper is hard, water safe and sun safe.
wristWhy: Wear red jasper on the right wrist. Courage and stamina stones are traditionally worn on the active, projecting side.
